no-restricted-syntax.message: Use semantic tokens (text-income, bg-expense-subtle, text-foreground…) not raw Tailwind palettes. See docs/design-system.md.
No hex codes in className. Use a semantic Tailwind token. If you genuinely need a new color, add a token first (docs/design-system.md → 'When to add a new token').
Use semantic tokens (text-income, bg-expense-subtle…) inside template literals, not raw Tailwind palettes.
Don't format currency ad-hoc — use <Money> from @/components/ui. Extend Money if it doesn't support your case.
